narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comedic product endorsement for the skincare brand TRUE TISANE. It uses a popular gaming influencer to first address a relatable community meme ('Goblin') and then positions the skincare set as a secret to maintaining good skin despite a typical gamer's lifestyle.
